Stack exactly these seven parts in this order, preserving Italian spelling:
1. "Visita di fisioterapia"
2. "45 minuti · 50 €"
3. Label "Orario", above a simple light gray rectangular read-only input containing "Martedì · 18:00"
4. Label "Nome", above a matching read-only input containing "Viola"
5. One full-width white action with a thin dark slate outline containing "Prenota la visita".

This is a deliberately unprioritized interface for teaching, so DO NOT enlarge or bold the heading or summary. No extra words, letters, numbers, artwork, icons, card enclosure or title other than those exact lines.
